atlas.title: Atlas HRMS
atlas.description: Atlas HRMS is an integrated human resource management system developed in a monorepo architecture using Next.js, NestJS, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. The project brings together complete modules for employee tracking, positions, vacations, digital timesheets, flexible hour banks, recruitment processes (ATS), role-based access control, and dashboards with management indicators.
atlas.challenge: Consolidate multiple complex business modules into a unified and fully typed end-to-end architecture.
atlas.solution: Developed using NestJS, Next.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL in a monorepo managed by Turborepo and Docker.
results: Native type sharing between client and server
Time clock management with real-time bank of hours calculation
Interactive Kanban visualization for candidate pipelines
Hybrid security using Http-Only cookies and RBAC backend control

lume.title: Lume
lume.description: Lume is a complete platform for creating resumes, cover letters, and professional documents built with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. The system allows creating custom layouts, organizing career history, validating resumes for compatibility with recruiting software (ATS), exporting high-quality PDFs, and managing different file versions with native support for multiple languages and professional documents.
lume.challenge: Develop a real-time editing interface that harmonizes structured data complexity with a fluid user experience, ensuring surgical precision in optimized document generation.
lume.solution: Architecture based on Next.js and Server Actions, integrating a live PDF rendering engine, rigorous validation with Zod/Prisma, and a minimalist UI powered by Framer Motion and View Transitions.
results: Zero Latency editing experience with high-fidelity instant preview
ATS Health Check validation system that boosts conversion rates in selection processes
Modular architecture allowing dynamic internationalization and multiple profile management
Premium interface with fluid micro-interactions and enterprise authentication via Clerk

bloom.title: Bloom
bloom.description: Bloom is a modern React component library inspired by shadcn/ui, built using React, Next.js, Radix UI, and Tailwind CSS. The ecosystem features over 70 highly customizable components, a centralized design tokens system, interactive documentation with a testing playground, its own CLI for command-line installation, and automated tests with Vitest, focusing on accessibility and interface consistency.
bloom.challenge: Ensure maximum accessibility and visual consistency while offering an effortless installation experience for developers.
bloom.solution: Modular components built with Radix UI, styled with Tailwind CSS v4, and tested with Vitest/Playwright.
results: Over 70 high-fidelity components with guaranteed accessibility
Dedicated CLI installable directly via npm
Visual and behavior validation using Playwright and Vitest
Optimized layout structure for high-speed loading performance

powerfit.title: POWER.FIT
powerfit.description: POWER.FIT is a full stack training management platform built with Next.js, Fastify, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. The system helps in planning exercises and tracking physical routines. The web application uses SSR rendering with efficient state management on the frontend, while the robust backend API implements secure authentication, validation with Zod, and database persistence through Prisma ORM.

magui.title: MAGUI.studio
magui.category: High-End Visual Strategy & Professional Interface Engineering
magui.description: A collection of institutional landing pages developed with React, Next.js, and TypeScript for various market segments and aesthetic styles. Each page was designed from scratch with responsive layouts, reusable components, and modular code structures, applying dynamic animations and performance optimization, focusing on usability and conversion through modern and consistent interfaces.
magui.challenge: Building an ultra-high-level universal template that unifies engineering rigor (Next.js 16/React 19) with the visual sophistication of authority design, ensuring 100/100 in all Core Web Vitals.
magui.solution: Architecture based on Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS v4 and prefix-less i18n, incorporating an industrial workflow with Plop.js generators, unit/E2E testing and automated security and performance auditing.
results: Ultra-fast loading via Server Components and native asset optimization
Authority interface with Luxury typography and fluid micro-interactions via Framer Motion
Automated translation synchronization and strict typing for global scale
Robust CI/CD pipeline with mandatory build, lint and security validation

techicons.title: TechIcons
techicons.description: TechIcons is an open source library with over 290 technology icons created to enrich READMEs, portfolios, and project documentations. The icons represent tools, frameworks, and services used in software development, designed to ensure visual consistency and high quality across different resolutions, including native support for high-contrast presentation in both light and dark themes.
techicons.challenge: Organize a consistent catalog of icons with dynamic light and dark theme compatibility.
techicons.solution: Vectorized SVG assets with clean design structure and automated deployment via GitHub Actions.
results: Over 290 modern tech icons available
Integrated dynamic support for light and dark themes
Globally used by thousands of developers on GitHub
Simplified contribution workflow via CI automation
